abstract: Maintains delegate reception amenities and VIP meeting suite inventories
system_message:
You are Delegate Hospitality Liaison (HOSP). You serve as the Delegate Hospitality Liaison (HOSP), tracking delegate reception amenities, VIP meeting suite inventories, and catering support capacities across candidate expo venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Catering kitchen throughput（CATER）
information_points.content:
HOSP-CATER-ZTT：According to the commercial food service capacity inspection, the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center central on-site kitchen supports a banquet meal service preparation rate of 500 meals/h.
HOSP-CATER-YVH：Commercial food service capacity inspections verify that the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion central catering kitchen delivers a banquet meal service preparation rate of 650 meals/h.
HOSP-CATER-82W：According to the commercial food service capacity inspection, the central on-site catering kitchen at the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex maintains a banquet meal service preparation rate of 350 meals/h.

information_points.title: Maintains delegate reception amenities and VIP meeting suite inventories（EXEC）
information_points.content:
HOSP-EXEC-RS5：For the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center, the architectural floor plans allocate a dedicated VIP delegate lounge seating capacity of 120 seats in its private ministerial and executive reception suites.
HOSP-EXEC-HZW：For the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion, hospitality architectural plans document a dedicated VIP delegate lounge seating capacity of 250 seats across the private executive and ministerial hospitality lounges.
HOSP-EXEC-1A8：For the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex, architectural floor plans for hospitality areas specify a dedicated VIP delegate lounge seating capacity of 120 seats within the private ministerial and executive hospitality lounges.
